name: shell_hooks_evaluate_result
notes: Harness is a traced copy of src/agent/shell_hooks_ports.c::shk_evaluate_result; twin drives LIVE agent/shell_hooks.py::_evaluate_result via a real ShellHookSpec and asserts outcome labels. Inputs restricted to semantics shared by C and LIVE (block/decision-block/context directives); the C port's parse_response does not implement 'modify'/'pre_verify' translation, so those shapes are deliberately not exercised (documented divergence, not faked). Cup hashes branch ladder + coarse outcome, not message strings (C timeout reason uses elapsed seconds vs LIVE spec.timeout).
